name: Ostlander Mercenaries
source: The New Mordheimer, Ostlander Mercenaries (Grade 1a) — full page text provided directly by the owner on 2026-07-06, as the site page itself currently 404s. Cited source: Town Cryer #11, revised in the Mordheim Annual 2002. Owner should cross-check against their own copy of that supplement/annual.

specialRules.note: The Elder is the oldest — or biggest — man in the village.

heroSlots.notes: The most respected men in the village aside from the Elder.

specialRules.note: A Priest of Taal may pray while wearing armour.

henchmenTypes.notes: Brothers and cousins of the Elder — the bulk of the warband.
Forest rangers with a taste for blackpowder weapons — the only Ostlanders with access to handguns, hunting rifles, and the double-barrelled versions.
May never use missile weapons (poor depth perception), even if an Advance roll would otherwise allow it.

specialRules.name: No Respect
specialRules.description: may never become the warband leader.

henchmenTypes.notes: statMaximums null: Ogres are not Human — fill from the Ogre Maximum Profile table if/when sourced.

specialRules.name: Large
specialRules.description: any model may shoot at the Ogre even if it isn't the closest target.

specialRules.name: Skills
specialRules.description: if promoted to Hero via "The lad's got talent", may choose from Combat and Strength skills.

specialRules.name: Slow-witted
specialRules.description: gains advances at half rate — must accrue twice the normal Experience per advance (the app's next-advance display doesn't model this doubling; track it manually).  Note the source's Ogre list prices a double-handed weapon at 10 gc (vs the usual 15).

exclusiveEquipment.name: Double-barrelled Pistol
exclusiveEquipment.restriction: Ostlander warbands only (Jaeger starting list; anyone in the warband via the Trading Post). 60 gc for a brace.
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: Range 6", Strength 4. Treated exactly like a normal pistol except each successful hit causes two S4 hits instead of one. Each barrel takes a full turn to reload (reloading only one barrel lets it fire like a normal pistol). A brace of double-barrelled pistols fires every other round rather than every round.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Double-barrelled Hunting Rifle
exclusiveEquipment.restriction: Ostlander warbands only (Jaeger starting list; anyone in the warband via the Trading Post).
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: Range 48", Strength 4. Treated exactly like a normal hunting rifle except each successful hit causes two hits instead of one. Each barrel takes a full turn to reload (reloading only one barrel lets it fire like a normal rifle).

specialRules: An Ostlander warband is an extended family — fathers, uncles, brothers, cousins, and the occasional tough-as-nails aunt — who pack up the whole village's manhood at the Elder's urging to seek their fortune in Mordheim. Self-Sufficient: Ostlanders have no desire to give their hard-earned gold to outsiders — they can never hire any Hired Swords except Ogres (a common sight in Ostland).
